title: Compass error
shortDescription: The Autel drone compass requires calibration or detects interference.
fullDescription:
Autel EVO and Nano drones use a magnetometer for heading. Interference or region change triggers a calibration prompt.

Calibrate outdoors away from metal objects. The drone will refuse auto-flight modes until passed.

If calibration fails repeatedly, the sensor may need service.

fixSteps.title: Move to open area
fixSteps.instruction: Away from metal, cars, power lines.

fixSteps.title: Perform rotation dance
fixSteps.instruction: Rotate drone horizontally then vertically as prompted.

whenToCallPro: Repeated failure in open environments requires service.

faq.a: Only when prompted or in new area.

title: GPS error
shortDescription: Insufficient satellites or GPS module fault.
fullDescription:
Autel requires 6+ satellites for GPS-assisted modes. Urban obstructions, tree cover, or hardware fault cause this error.

Move to open sky and wait for lock. If hardware fault, service required.

title: Gimbal error
fullDescription:
Autel gimbal performs startup check; obstruction or bent arm causes error. Remove gimbal clamp before boot.

Calibration via Autel Explorer can recover soft faults. Mechanical damage needs service.

fixSteps.title: Restart on level
fixSteps.instruction: Place on flat surface and power cycle.

title: Firmware update failed
shortDescription: Autel firmware update did not complete.
fullDescription:
Firmware update requires stable connection and sufficient battery. Interruptions leave device in inconsistent state.

Autel Explorer app or Autel Assistant on PC can recover. Ensure 50%+ battery on drone and RC.

fixSteps.title: Use Autel Assistant
fixSteps.instruction: Connect to PC and reflash via Autel Assistant desktop tool.

whenToCallPro: If drone bricked, Autel RMA required.
videoSearchQuery: Autel drone firmware update failed fix

faq.a: Only specific versions via Autel Assistant.

title: Battery error
shortDescription: Smart battery detects cell imbalance or fault.
fullDescription:
Autel Intelligent Batteries monitor each LiPo cell. Imbalance beyond threshold or over-discharge triggers error and blocks flight.

Leave battery on charger for auto-balance; discard if swollen.

fixSteps.title: Full charge cycle
fixSteps.instruction: Charge to 100% and leave on charger 1 hour for balancing.

faq.q: Can I revive deeply discharged battery?
faq.a: Sometimes via trickle charge; often not safe.

title: Motor overcurrent
shortDescription: A motor is drawing abnormal current.
fullDescription:
ESC protects motor by cutting power when current exceeds safe limit. Usually caused by obstruction, bad bearing, or damaged prop.

Clean motor thoroughly; replace damaged parts.

fixSteps.title: Inspect motors
fixSteps.instruction: Spin by hand; should be free and silent.

fixSteps.title: Replace motor
fixSteps.instruction: If bearings gritty, replace motor assembly.

faq.q: Can I fly with one bad motor?

title: Image transmission lost
shortDescription: Live video from drone is disconnected.
fullDescription:
SkyLink / AutelLink HD feed lost due to interference, range, or antenna orientation.

Align antennas perpendicular to drone; avoid 2.4/5.8 GHz crowded areas.

fixSteps.title: Switch frequency
fixSteps.instruction: Auto mode lets drone pick cleanest channel.

videoSearchQuery: Autel drone image transmission lost fix

title: Remote paired failed
shortDescription: Drone and RC could not link.
fullDescription:
Pairing requires matching firmware and correct procedure. Keep devices close and press link button within timeout.

Firmware mismatch is most common cause.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Match versions on drone and RC.

fixSteps.title: Re-pair procedure
fixSteps.instruction: Hold link button on drone 3s, then RC within 30s.

faq.q: Can I use old RC with new drone?
faq.a: Must be same model and firmware compatible.

title: SD card error
shortDescription: microSD card is slow, full, or corrupt.
fullDescription:
Autel 6K/8K video needs V30/V60 cards. Slow cards drop frames; corrupt filesystems fail writes.

Format in drone; replace with fast branded card.

title: RTH activated due to low battery
shortDescription: Drone is auto-returning because battery is near critical level.
fullDescription:
Autel computes return distance and initiates RTH when barely enough charge remains. User has short window to cancel.

Let drone return safely; replace battery; check cold weather effects.

fixSteps.title: Allow RTH
fixSteps.instruction: Let drone return; do not cancel unless safe landing nearby.

fixSteps.title: Land and swap battery
fixSteps.instruction: Replace with charged battery before next flight.

faq.a: Brief window allows cancel; critical land still occurs.
